market.icp: Privacy-conscious meeting participants who need local-first notes
market.buyerPain: An exported AI summary can omit the meeting goal and other owner notes that provide its context.
market.revenueHypothesis: Reliable, local-first note capture increases confidence in the free MVP before any paid offering is evaluated.

increment.name: meeting-export-owner-context
acceptanceCriteria: A non-empty meeting goal is copied into the started meeting note.
The meeting-goal input accepts no more than 280 characters.
The meeting-goal input explains that its value pre-fills the local note.
The meeting-goal input shows its current character count against the limit.
Markdown export preserves local owner notes before an available AI summary.
A blank meeting goal still starts with a blank note.

delivery.checker: separate local build and source-behavior assertions
delivery.rollback: Revert only the Markdown export composition change.
delivery.stopCondition: Stop after one local verified increment; do not deploy, submit to an app store, or change licensing.
